rules.triggerCondition: Triggered when clicking a province on MapaCostaRica that is NOT the player’s currentLocation.
rules.deductionMoment: Coins are checked (>= 5000) and deducted immediately upon confirming travel in NewRegion() before the random question from that province is shown.
rules.singleChoiceBehavior: Rendered as up to 6 direct buttons (Respuesta1..Respuesta6). Clicking a correct option (+1 >= minScore) immediately unlocks travel, moves the player avatar, plays sfx 36 (win-sound.m4a), and if the province star state is "000", plays the province welcome voiceover.
rules.multipleChoiceBehavior: Rendered as up to 10 toggles in two columns (tglRespuesta1..10) with an "Evaluate" button (btnEvaluar). Each checked correct option adds +1 and each checked wrong option subtracts -1 (PreguntaController.OptionValue). Clicking "Evaluate" checks if currentScore >= minScore.
rules.onWrongAnswer: Plays sfx 37 (wrong.m4a), closes PanelPregunta without refunding the travel fee, and leaves player at previous location.
